title: Can Pinnacle Blooms Network assist in improving my child's interpersonal relationships?
metaTitle: Building Positive Relationships Through Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network employs occupational therapy to help your child understand social norms, strengthening their social interaction skills and building positive relationships.
html: Yes, absolutely! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, our dedicated occupational therapists endeavour to improve your child's understanding and adoption of social norms and behaviours. Utilising strategies like role-play, social stories, each session is designed to foster their social interaction skills, hence paving the path to build valuable and positive relationships.
